'''Scooty''' is a [[goblin]] [[quest giver]] located in [[Booty Bay]] in [[Stranglethorn Vale]]. He maintains the teleporter, and claims to be a "master [[engineer]]".

* {{questlong|Horde|35D|Gnomer-gooooone!}} {{queststartfinish}}

==Quotes==
;Gossip
Hello, <name>! I am master engineer, Scooty.

==Trivia==
*Clearly an homage to Lt. Cmdr. Montgomery "Scotty" Scott, the chief engineer of the ''U.S.S. Enterprise'' from the ''Star Trek'' universe. Note the additional existence of {{NPC||Sprok|Away Team}} in [[Gnomeregan]].
